thesis: A directionally efficient M5 impulse followed by a controlled pullback and fast causal reacceleration has a higher probability of persisting in the impulse direction when impulse quality, pullback geometry, recovery speed, tick pressure and spread jointly agree.

bar_contract.ATR14: Wilder ATR14 from completed M15 Bid OHLC
bar_contract.clock: preserve raw Darwinex/New-York-Close source clock; no UTC relabeling

impulse_event.direction: BUY if M5 close>open; SELL if close<open

pullback_reacceleration.observation_starts: first tick after impulse bar close
pullback_reacceleration.reacceleration_level: 10% retracement from impulse close toward impulse open
pullback_reacceleration.reacceleration: after minimum retracement is reached, first Bid tick returning through reacceleration_level in impulse direction before invalidation/window expiry
pullback_reacceleration.entry_quote: first strictly positive-spread quote at-or-after confirmation time and before source-day end
pullback_reacceleration.overlap_cap: at most one completed IPS event per direction per source-clock M5 bar; a new impulse may arm only when no same-direction impulse state remains active

recovery_speed.formula: clip((reacceleration_speed/pullback_speed)/2,0,1) using impulse-close to pullback-extreme distance/time and extreme to reacceleration-level distance/time

micro_pressure.formula: directional sign imbalance of last 64 non-zero mid-price changes ending at confirmation, mapped to [0,1]

score: 0..100 fixed weighted sum; no fitted weights

prediction.entry: confirmation quote: BUY Ask / SELL Bid

ranking_diagnostic.hard_gate: Spearman rho between non-empty bin mean score and bin hit rate >0; strict adjacent monotonicity is diagnostic only, not a hard gate

forbidden: fitting weights to PnL or hit rate
using QFAES or QRPI outcomes as IPS features
claiming final edge from development alone
